name: Junior Volunteer Summer Program
city: Orlando, Lake Nona, Lake Baldwin, Viera and Daytona, FL
what_you_do: Serve Veterans in a hospital or clinic over the summer. You must give at least 100 volunteer hours.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 17 who can commit to at least 100 hours. You cannot be placed where your parent or guardian works.
duration: About 10 weeks (June 3 to Aug 6 in 2026); 100 hour minimum
deadline_text: In 2026 applications were accepted on one day only, April 15, 2026, by email. Expect a similar one day window in spring 2027, not yet posted.
how_to_apply: Email a packet to vhaorlvoluntary@va.gov. Use the subject "Summer Junior Volunteer - Location Name". It is first come, first served. A parent must go to an online orientation. The student goes to an in person orientation.
notes: Applications were taken by email on 1 day only, April 15, 2026, first come first served. Sites in 2026: Lake Nona, Lake Baldwin, Viera and Daytona. Volunteers cannot be placed where a parent or guardian works.
